text.en: This Order may be cited as the Income Tax Act (Amendment) (No.2) Order, 2020 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st April 2014. of section llE of Chapter 35

heading.en: Amendment of section llE of Chapter 35

text.en: Section llE of the Income Tax Act, in this Order referred to as the Act, is by deleting "Tabung Amanah Pekerja (Employee Trust Fund) under section 6 of the Tabung Amanah Pekerja Act" from the second and third lines and by substituting "Employee Trust established by section 6 of the Employee Trust Act" therefor. of section llF

Section llF of the Act is amended by deleting "Fund under section 8 of the Supplemental Contributory Pensions Order, 2009" from the second and third and by substituting "under section 8 of the Supplemental Contributory Trust Order, 2009" therefor. of section llG

Section llG of the Act is amended by deleting "Tabung Amanah Pekerja (Employee Trust Fund)" from the third line and by substituting "Employee Trust by section 6 of the Employee Trust Act (Chapter 167)" therefor. of section 42AA

Section 42AA of the Act is amended, in subsection (2){a}(iii), by deleting Amanah Pekerja (Employee Trust Fund) established under Tabung Pekerja Act" and by substituting "Employee Trust established by section 6 of the Employee Trust Act" therefor. of section 42AB

the Act is amended, in subsection (2){c}, by deleting "Tabung Pekerja (Employee Trust Fund) established under the Tabung Amanah and by substituting "Employee Trust established by section 6 of the Employee Trust Act" therefor. day of Syawal, 1441 Hijriah corresponding to the 8th. day of June, 2020 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, DARUSSALAM.
